claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves LG 18650HE2 2500mAh 8C as a 2500mAh preset with a 8C runtime rating.
Battery Mooch assessed this tested exact model at 20A continuous discharge.
LG HE2 is documented as an unprotected flat-top 18650 cell, approximately 18.3 mm x 65.0 mm; this describes the named product format and does not establish the OEM identity of every wrapped sample.
LG 18650HE2 is documented as a lithium-ion cell with an NMC (Li[NiMnCo]O2) cathode and graphite-based anode.
The exact catalog entry LG 18650HE2 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2015-12-05 or earlier.
